options.label: Midnight Transit Diagram
options.description: Project accountability as a transit network where stations are projects, lines are status flows, and interchanges are discrepancies. Municipal officials know transit diagrams intimately.
options.thesis: Organizes projects as a network diagram with status-colored lines, refusing flat tables that hide dependencies
options.palette: Midnight-blue enamel (#0A1929), scarlet (#E63946) for flagged, cobalt (#2A9D8F) for verified, amber (#F4A261) for pending
options.materials: Porcelain station markers, status lines at 45/90-degree angles, interchange alerts for discrepancies
options.firstViewport: Left rail nav (260px), main splits: network diagram showing projects as stations with colored status lines (left, flex), live stats panel (right, 380px)
options.honestRisk: The transit metaphor may feel abstract initially until users recognize the status flow pattern
options.case: Municipal officials understand transit diagrams - they use them daily. The line/interchange model clarifies complex project dependencies better than tables.

options.label: Survey Cadastral Map
options.description: Official government survey map aesthetic with coordinate grids, zone overlays, boundary markers, and legend box. Familiar visual language from municipal planning.
options.thesis: Projects mapped as surveyed zones with official cadastral precision, refusing generic pin-on-map interfaces
options.palette: Survey paper (#F5F3ED), official green (#2C4A3A), zone colors (verified green, pending amber, flagged red), ruled grid lines
options.materials: Topographic grid overlay, zone boundaries, coordinate boxes, scale bars, legend with status swatches
options.firstViewport: Tool sidebar (72px), legend panel (280px), main map view with zone overlays and project markers, floating project detail card
options.honestRisk: This is the most familiar government aesthetic - safe but predictable choice for municipal software

options.label: Split-Flap Concourse Board
options.description: Real-time project board styled as an airport/rail concourse split-flap display. Ruled rows, live cascading updates, status lamps.
options.thesis: Live project monitoring as a split-flap departure board, refusing static lists that hide real-time changes
options.palette: Matte black (#1C1C1C) with white letters, status lamps (green verified, amber pending, red flagged with glow)
options.materials: Ruled tabular rows, condensed sans on black flaps, LED-style status indicators, brushed metal frame
options.firstViewport: Full-width board with header (brand + time), ruled column headers, live project rows with status lamps, footer stats
options.honestRisk: The split-flap aesthetic is striking but may feel more like a display than a working tool
options.case: The ruled rows match register format perfectly, and real-time cascading updates fit live project monitoring.

reroll.safer: More conventional grounded candidates plus the category standard
reroll.bolder: Foreign forms only, at full commitment

canon.label: Category Standard
canon.description: Clean municipal dashboard with sidebar navigation, data tables, map view, and card-based project details - the expected pattern
